captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a photographer's beauty dish mounted on a boom arm and tripod. It features a black tripod base with three thin spreading legs, a tall vertical metallic gray post, a black swivel clamp joint, a horizontal metallic boom arm with a cylindrical counterweight, a black mounting yoke, and a large, shallow beige-colored circular dish with a central gray deflector plate. The assembly articulates via a revolute joint where the clamp rotates on the vertical post, a revolute tilt joint for the horizontal boom, and a revolute joint allowing the dish yoke to tilt at the end of the arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a photography beauty dish on a boom arm with a tripod base. The model should include a three-legged folding tripod base, a vertical support post, a clamping joint that allows the horizontal boom arm to rotate and tilt, a counterweight, and a large circular reflector dish on a tilting yoke mount.
captions.factory: The code constructs the tripod base by combining three cylindrical legs with spherical feet around a central hub cylinder. The vertical post is built using a long cylinder, topped with a block-shaped clamp joint. The horizontal boom arm is created from a cylinder passing through the clamp, finished with a cylindrical counterweight on one end and a U-shaped mounting yoke on the other. The beauty dish is generated as a thin-walled cone section (using a subtracted cone or loft) combined with a central circular deflector plate, which is attached to the yoke via a cylindrical pivot pin.
